card.text: M26 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 1,835 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 26, also known as NGC 6694, is an open cluster of stars in the southern constellation of Scutum.

introduction.text: M26 is drawn as 434 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
